root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward bringing or pressing things together, especially in a way that closes, covers, encloses, or makes them closely compact.
root_idea.development: This orientation extends to shutting doors and entrances, covering something over, enclosing people or animals, forecourts connected to dwellings, and vegetation with closely gathered roots.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized passive-participial citation form مُؤْصَدٌ.
Displayed under its supplied lexical noun citation form وَصِيدٌ.

senses.definition: Closed over; tightly shut so as to enclose what is within.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the feminine form مُؤْصَدَةٌ describes the Fire as firmly closed over those within it.

senses.definition: A forecourt, threshold, or doorway—the entrance area of a dwelling or cavern.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic account of the Companions of the Cave, the word is interpreted as the forecourt, threshold, or entrance of the cave.
This is an alternative Quranic interpretation of وَصِيدٌ in the Companions of the Cave passage.

senses.definition: A closed or covered enclosure; something shut over.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-linked lexicographic interpretation associated with the وَصِيدٌ passage and a variant vocalization; it is not assigned a separate modern Quran location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To close or shut a door or entrance; to block or stop it up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related passive usage describes a door or entrance becoming closed. The action may also be used of an obstruction stopping an entrance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Closed or become closed, especially of a door or entrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of an entrance that is shut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cover over a cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete covering use distinct from shutting a door or entrance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, to straiten someone or impose an unbearable difficulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application to putting a person under severe constraint.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a fold or enclosure for sheep or goats in a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction refers to preparing a mountain enclosure for livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone fold or enclosure in the mountains for sheep, goats, or other flocks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The stone enclosure is distinguished from a branch-built حظيرة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chamber made in a mountain for keeping property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A mountain-made enclosure for possessions, distinct from the livestock fold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbage whose roots grow close together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning describes compact growth at the roots.
